# `from_protobuf`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Converts a binary Protobuf value into a Catalyst value.

**Applies to:** not available in Krishiv yet. Spark: 4.0 and later.

## Syntax

```text
from_protobuf(data, messageName, descFilePath, options)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `protobuf_funcs` |
| Kind | unknown (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | [2, 3, 4] |

## Examples

```sql
-- from_protobuf, example 1
> SELECT from_protobuf(s, 'Person', '/path/to/descriptor.desc', map()) IS NULL AS result FROM (SELECT NAMED_STRUCT('name', name, 'id', id) AS s FROM VALUES ('John Doe', 1), (NULL,  2) tab(name, id));
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```
